title: Surreal Einstein Portrait
description: A surreal black and white line drawing of Albert Einstein wearing a beret and smoking a cigarette, with a large stylized third eye on his forehead containing a red planet, silhouetted figures, and a blue ring. The background features a dark cosmic scene with floating geometric shapes, a film reel, a molecular structure, tentacle-like forms, and a red sun over jagged mountains.
